description: Find eSIM data plans for a destination, with final prices in minor units. Use it first, when a traveler needs mobile data abroad: filter by country (ISO code), region, minimum data, validity and price, then compare. Returns results (each with id, title, countries, regions, data_gb or "unlimited", validity_days, price_final {amount_minor, currency, tax_included}, availability, delivery, refund_rule and constraints such as hotspot, network types and operators), total_matches, sort and excluded_suppliers. Defaults: in-stock plans only, cheapest first, 10 results. Read-only and free; pass a result's id to get_quote. Suppliers below the trust threshold are excluded and listed in excluded_suppliers. Example: {country: "JP", min_data_gb: 5, max_validity_days: 30, sort: "price"}.

agent_key.description: Secret returned by register_agent (or X-Agent-Key header)

category.description: Product category; only esim is sold

country.description: Destination country as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, for example JP, US, GB or TH

include_out_of_stock.description: true: also list plans that are out of stock (default false)

max_price_minor.description: Highest acceptable final price in minor units (1500 = 15.00 USD)

max_validity_days.description: Longest acceptable validity in days, for example 30

min_data_gb.description: Minimum data in GB; unlimited plans always qualify

min_validity_days.description: Shortest acceptable validity in days, for example 7

principal_id.description: The principal you act for (or X-Principal-Id header)

region.description: Coverage region (EUROPE, ASIA, MIDDLE_EAST, NORTH_AMERICA, LATIN_AMERICA, OCEANIA, AFRICA or GLOBAL); use country for one destination

sort.description: price (default, cheapest first), price_per_gb (best value per GB) or validity (longest first)

name: search_plans
title: Search eSIM plans
